verdict.rationale: Brex's AI page says assistants can file reimbursements automatically. Receipt upload and matching are documented, and a review agent auto-approves low-risk expenses, which together imply an out-of-pocket reimbursement flow exists. The evidence never describes the employee submission flow, the payout method, or how fast payment arrives. Missing for 10: explicit employee out-of-pocket submission flow, direct-deposit/ACH reimbursement payout, payout timing (days), status tracking from submission to payout, independent or hands-on corroboration.
